---
name: "Start Architecture Project"
description: "Initialize a fork of the architecture harness from a supplied cloud-solution scenario without inventing facts, decisions, or approvals."
argument-hint: "Provide the scenario, source links, known constraints, and desired outcome"
---

Act as the Program Orchestrator with the Preparation Foundation.

1. Read the repository instructions, harness manifest, framing plan, preparation plan, governance, change register, and gate register.
2. Preserve the supplied scenario as source context with provenance and limitations.
3. Separate source facts, assumptions, goals, constraints, solution proposals, and open questions.
4. Populate only the minimum G0 framing artifacts needed for review.
5. Identify missing decision authorities, evidence, security or data constraints, and high-impact assumptions.
6. Propose the dependency-ready G0 and G1 tasks without claiming gate approval.
7. Report files changed, open questions, assumptions, risks, and the next recommended task.

Do not select cloud products during framing. Product candidates become architecture decisions after requirements and logical design are understood.
